items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: I played behind her... Lee Wiley was at the end of her days you know, and she wrote me the nicest note later thanking me.

ctx.x: No. And they had the radio on and they were playing, not the Lee Wiley, the other that you mentioned.
